blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Dominion Holdings Inc.’s planned takeover of the Tampakan copper-gold project has cleared another key hurdle after its shareholders approved on Monday the listed firm’s proposed merger with two companies that hold rights over the project’s operator. In a stock exchange filing yesterday, the Sy- and Consunji-backed firm said its shareholders had given the green light to the planned merger with Indophil Resources Phils. Inc. and Sonar Holdings Inc.
